limitations: No exhaustive search of design space
Unresolved games are resumable, not draws
Wilson intervals ignore pairing and policy dependence; descriptive only
Bootstrap uses decided pairs only and excludes unresolved-pair selection effects
Independent seeds/policies alone do not certify fairness
AI metrics do not prove human enjoyment
Finite-horizon neutral is not a draw proof
Exact duplicates only; rotations/reflections retained with player identities
Wall usage is not causal evidence of strategic necessity
